wedges.label: Revisit
wedges.note: Gemini writes a follow-up from a past conversation you marked 'we talked about it'. These are used until there is enough history, or if the AI is unavailable.
questions: What's a conversation we've had this year that you keep thinking about?
Is there something one of us said recently that deserves a second conversation?
What's one thing we talked about lately that we haven't actually acted on yet?
What's a question you wish I'd ask you again, now that some time has passed?
Which of our recent talks changed how you see me, even a little?

talkTonightPrompts.aligned: You're on the same page here. What would it look like to actually do something about it this week?
talkTonightPrompts.different: You see this differently. Ask each other: what's behind your answer?
talkTonightPrompts.oneShort: One of you said a lot more. Ask the other to tell you more.
talkTonightPrompts.default: Pick the one line from each other's answer that surprised you, and start there.
